claim.label: architecture note
claim.sentence: Unitree G1 architecture note The base G1 ships with a low-power onboard controller; EDU variants add a Jetson Orin NX for perception and policy workloads, which is why most published research on the platform uses the EDU configuration.

value.text: The base G1 ships with a low-power onboard controller; EDU variants add a Jetson Orin NX for perception and policy workloads, which is why most published research on the platform uses the EDU configuration.

evidence.excerpt: Compute options differ between the base and EDU configurations on the product page.
